payload.summary: Validated commit cf1522bd at tier B. Spec compliance and every changed-surface unit/static gate passed; deploy, smoke, live security, and browser E2E were not applicable, while repository-wide environment and import-isolation gaps were recorded separately.

decisions.title: Honor declared non-deployable surface
decisions.rationale: work-packages.yaml explicitly declares deployable: false, so deployment-dependent phases are not applicable.

decisions.title: Do not treat environment gaps as code failures
decisions.rationale: Focused changed-surface suites pass; absent PostgreSQL, missing import stubs, and flat-module collection collisions are repository environment/isolation gaps.
